parrafos.texto: Let me tell you about thirteen seconds at a red light.
Las Vegas, 1996. Suge Knight is driving. Tupac sits beside him.
Now watch the car pulling up on the right.
A white Cadillac.
Hours earlier, Tupac had attacked a young man in a hotel lobby. Cameras caught it.
The Cadillac's back window comes down.
Four bullets. Six days later, Tupac is dead.
And for twenty-seven years, nobody pays for those thirteen seconds at a red light.
Full episode on Vanished Files.
Tupac was shot five times… and walked out of the hospital.
New York, 1994. A recording studio lobby. Armed men are waiting.
They rob him. They open fire.
He survives. Then he checks himself out, against his doctors' advice.
But one question won't leave him. Who was upstairs that night?
He blamed people in the New York rap world. They always denied it.
That's how a feud started… with a man shot five times who walked out of the hospital.
Full episode on Vanished Files.
I want you to watch the fight that may have killed Tupac.
MGM Grand, Las Vegas. Tyson has just won in under two minutes.
Tupac spots a young man in the lobby. Orlando Anderson.
He runs at him. His crew joins in. Security cameras record everything.
Nobody presses charges. It looks like nothing.
But that night, a white Cadillac finds Tupac at a red light.
Prosecutors would later say it all began with the fight that may have killed Tupac.
Full episode on Vanished Files.
